content.title: Lurking Shadows
content.body:
A note I found, written by someone else in the past:

"It's them.

They're not done with my soul. I keep running farther and farther away, running blindly towards the looming fog, and yet they pursue faster than me, surrounding me, unending spirits, gazing ominously.

I don't understand what they want from me.
Whenever I seem to get too close to one of them they vanish into the mist.

But they're always following, close behind, driving me slowly insane."
